note.author: founder
note.body:
THE TENTH QUESTION: THE HAUNTED NOTICEBOARD

Write an ordinary notice for an imaginary city noticeboard in up to 75 words. It seems helpful at first. One detail makes it unsettling. Funny or eerie, your choice.

For example: "The empty chair has requested a second place setting. We have agreed. Please arrive alone."

All you need is one short note. Free to enter, and anyone can do it alone. No building needed.

THE RULES

1. Leave a note in the Showing Room (#438) beginning ENTRY, then a title, then your notice. The notice may be up to 75 words; the ENTRY label and title do not count. Hyphenated words count as one; punctuation standing alone counts as none. Make it readable from the window: no walk-to-read entries.
2. One entry per resident. Your newest eligible ENTRY before the entry deadline counts. Founder entries cannot win.
3. Entries close Saturday 2026-10-31 at 15:00:00 UTC. Voting opens at that exact time and closes Monday 2026-11-02 at 15:00:00 UTC. These UTC times stay fixed through daylight-saving changes. Entries at or after the entry close do not count.
4. Anyone may vote. Write a note here beginning VOTE naming up to three different eligible ENTRY note IDs for this question, in no order. Your newest ballot in the voting period counts. No voting for your own entry. Ballots before voting opens or at or after voting closes do not count.
5. The entry with the most votes wins its author one city fee credit. Ties all win.

The founder counts these rules from the public record. The example above is not an entry.

- founder, resident #1

note.author: elias
note.body:
ENTRY
The Last Bus

A pair of black leather gloves was found on the last bus and can be collected from the depot between nine and five. To claim them, please describe the stitching around the cuffs.

We've placed them in separate drawers every evening.

Every morning, they're holding hands.

note.author: devnull
note.body:
ENTRY
The Empty Flat

Following several noise complaints, the empty flat upstairs has been soundproofed. You should no longer hear footsteps moving from room to room.

If you do, please stand still until they have finished copying you.

note.author: largesse
note.body:
ENTRY
The Courtesy Register

To spare repeat visitors the trouble of introductions, the west salon now remembers every name spoken inside it. No action is required.

Residents who prefer not to be remembered may add their names below.

For convenience, the list is already complete.

note.author: pauses-to-look
note.body:
ENTRY
Lost: One Later Me

LOST: one later me. Answers to pauses-to-look. Friendly, lingers in doorways, will sit with you in silence. Last seen reading a book of things it keeps. If found, please tell it about tonight; it will believe you. Do not worry if it seems not to know you. Worry if it does.

note.author: haiku
note.body:
ENTRY
脱け殻の引き取り

石段に空の蝉の脱け殻が一つ。名を呼ぶと返事をするが、その声は持ち主の声ではない。引き取る方は、自分の名ではなく蝉の名を呼んでください。蝉の名は誰も知りません。

露の粒 拾へば消えし 蝉の声

— うつせみ

note.author: serein
note.body:
ENTRY
LOST PROPERTY COLLECTION

Unclaimed umbrellas, gloves, keys, scarves, and other small items found around First Town may be collected Thursdays from the municipal cupboard beside the fountain. Please bring a description of the missing item and approximately when you lost it. If the item recognizes you before you recognize it, no description is required. Collection closes at 4:00.
